name: Original Renault NonPlayable armor visibility and Take All

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 1280
resolution y = 720
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local timer=0;local expected=nil;local aim=nil
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;if timer<.2 then return end;timer=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original Renault corpse loot')
 local a=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x032a15));assert(a and a:isValid() and types.Actor.isDead(a),'Original Renault corpse unavailable')
 local source=types.Actor.inventory(a);local player=types.Actor.inventory(self)
 if not expected then expected={{}};for _,item in ipairs(source:getAll()) do local hidden={{[core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x022f71)]=true,[core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x022f70)]=true,[core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x022f6f)]=true,[core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x022f65)]=true,[core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x022f20)]=true}};expected[item.recordId]=player:countOf(item.recordId)+(hidden[item.recordId] and 0 or source:countOf(item.recordId));print('MergeRenault original loot item='..item.recordId..' count='..source:countOf(item.recordId)) end;assert(next(expected),'Original corpse must have loot') end
 local transferred=#source:getAll()==0
 for id,count in pairs(expected) do if player:countOf(id)~=count then transferred=false end end
 if transferred then print('MergeRenault corpse loot transferred');return end
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 local distance=(self.position-a.position):length()

 local box=a:getBoundingBox()
 local previousAim=aim
 if not aim or nearby.castRenderingRay(camera.getPosition(),aim,{{ignore=self}}).hitObject~=a then
  aim=nil
  for _,z in ipairs({{.5,.8,0,-.5,-.8}}) do
   for _,x in ipairs({{0,-.35,.35,-.7,.7}}) do
    for _,y in ipairs({{0,-.35,.35,-.7,.7}}) do
     local point=box.center+util.vector3(x*box.halfSize.x,y*box.halfSize.y,z*box.halfSize.z)
     local hit=nearby.castRenderingRay(camera.getPosition(),point,{{ignore=self}})
     if hit.hitObject==a then
      local p=hit.hitPos or point
      if not aim or (p-camera.getPosition()):length()<(aim-camera.getPosition()):length() then aim=p end
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 if not aim then aim=previousAim or box.center;print('MergeRenault corpse target occluded, retaining turn point') end
 local distance=(aim-camera.getPosition()):length();local limit=tonumber(core.getGMST('iMaxActivateDist'))
 print('MergeRenault camera activation distance='..distance..' limit='..limit)
 if distance<limit*.95 then print('MergeRenault corpse in activation range') end
 local localPoint=camera.getViewTransform():apply(aim)
 local yaw=math.atan2(localPoint.x,-localPoint.z)
 local pitch=-math.atan2(localPoint.y,math.sqrt(localPoint.x*localPoint.x+localPoint.z*localPoint.z))
 local origin=camera.getPosition();local view=camera.viewportToWorldVector(util.vector2(.5,.5))
 local focused=nearby.castRenderingRay(origin,origin+view*2000,{{ignore=self}})
 if focused.hitObject==a then print('MergeRenault corpse loot heading') end
if focused.hitObject==a and focused.hitPos and (focused.hitPos-origin):length()<tonumber(core.getGMST('iMaxActivateDist')) then print('MergeRenault corpse loot facing') end
 print(string.format('MergeRenault corpse loot aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(pitch*256+.5)))))
end}}}}
